summary: Tests that call the real AI are slow, cost money and change every time. You hand the function a fake client, so a test runs in a blink and gives the same answer every time. You write tests for the normal case, an edge case and an error case with pytest.
goal: Write a pytest test that checks an AI function without calling the real model.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: add pytest, run the 4 tests and match 4 passed
Step 2: change max_words to 4, predict which test fails, then read the message
Step 3: comment out the empty-text check and read DID NOT RAISE
Step 4: write summarize_or_default and its two tests (6 passed)
